Mixed feelings on this game. Good graphics etc but the prizes in the chests are rubbish. Feel when you are spending real money you should receive good items in the chests not weaker things to what you own already. The campaign is the only worth while thing as you get good prizes completing that. I'm enjoying this game at the moment but think i will get bored quite quickly of the poor prizes in the chests. Think things need to improve quite a bit.

I have been playing well over a year. I have had an avatar switched with another players avatar and can not get it back. I have tried contacting twice to no avail. There have been zero upgrades and no additions made to the map quest stuck at 60. The only updates are to the amounts of ads that have now doubled from 30 seconds to 60 second, meaning that every time you do something requiring to watch an ad now requires you to watch 2. A big ask for no game improvement in such a long time.
